mission.title: Slowdown
mission.description: Terminate programs overridden by the intruder, then take a squad from Agent Pace and sweep the sites where his codes are active.

npc.say: We're not saying this for our own sakes, dear--but the citizens you're supposed to be protecting are having an awfully hard time getting their forty winks with that glowing guy clonking around.
Time to put up or shut up.

phase.briefing: Greetings, {player}. Programs overridden by the intruder continue to be an issue. Once under his control they are no longer responsive to System directives, and must be terminated before they can cause further damage.

enter.say:
I've got signals in there, should be the poor overridden programs.
Huh... I'm also seeing a few redpill signals. Don't know who that might be, so be careful.

talk.say:
This just won't do, dearie. The Machines have decided to let the intruder do whatever he wants, but how long do you think you can go around cleaning up the messes he makes?
If they haven't got the guts to stand up to him, then maybe they should step aside for those who can.

done.say: Yeah, great. Why don't we just put her in charge of the simulation...

phase.briefing:
Operative, we would like to carry on a civil discussion with the intruder, but he has not replied to our requests, and his program overrides are making it...difficult for us to contact him.
We are attempting to track his movements. High concentrations of his override codes can be detected with relative facility; however, they can also be dangerous. I am sending you to receive reinforcements from Agent Pace.

enter.say:
In a way, it's kind of nice that they have to rely on us more than their own programs against this intruder guy.
On the other hand, Agents would come in handy sometimes...

talk.say:
Believe me, {player}, we would like nothing better than to have the intruder out of the System. If only it were as easy as terminating an Exile, or destroying a hovercraft...
As it is, we must proceed carefully. You understand, yes?
Please take these programs with you. They will help if you encounter programs turned against us by the intruder's codes.

done.say: Buona fortuna, tesoro! We are very grateful for your help.

objective.text: Lead Taylor Bonner and Lupe Chatterton out of the area

phase.briefing: Take your squad to the indicated coordinates and search the area, operative. Eliminate any hostile programs you find, but remember that your primary goal is to locate the intruder.

enter.say: Override codes are active in there--multiple readings.

done.say: Nothing but little ones; looks like the intruder's still a step ahead of us.

objective.text: Do not let Taylor Bonner and Lupe Chatterton die

phase.briefing: There is...no other way to stop this problem than by negotiating with the intruder himself. We must locate him.

enter.say:
More of the code readings in there...
Hm, and I think I see a big one, too. Maybe we're in luck.

Whoa! Oh, great. Not exactly the wireframed guy we were looking for.
Uh... Just get the regular ones. We can probably leave that floating thing for... Well, heck, we don't get paid enough for that.

mission.finish: Hm... Thank you, {player}. Clearly, establishing contact with the target is proving more difficult than expected. We will have to bring more forces to bear on this problem.
